name: desktopctl
description: Control the local Windows desktop with visible green activity indicators.

interface.shortDescription: Control local Windows apps, input, windows, and screenshots.
interface.longDescription: A desktop-only plugin that exposes the portable desktopctl executable as structured local tools. Every desktop operation requires a visible green activity session.
defaultPrompt: Use Desktop Control to list the available applications on this Windows computer.
Use Desktop Control to open an application, activate its window, and take a screenshot.
